title: Capability Declaration, v1
description: What an agent declares it can do, and what the router is allowed to conclude from that declaration. A declaration is a CLAIM; every field that could be mistaken for evidence is typed so it cannot be.

x-provenance.why: GA's file was reported at feat/ga-2026-08-17-contracts-v1 / 33cadf72; that ref does not exist on origin and the commit is not in this repository. Authored by explicit human instruction rather than waiting for another failed delivery.
x-provenance.derivation: Routing structure read from docs/policy/anfis-objective.md and docs/policy/authority-policy.v0.5.yaml at blob 2b3374bb (xc/policy-lock, d88693b). No constant here was invented; fields the policy does not specify are listed under x-unspecified.
x-provenance.lane_note: Crosses the XC/GA/CC lane split by instruction. GA's authored version should REPLACE this, not merge with it.

schema_version.description: Versioned so the router can refuse a declaration it does not understand rather than reading unknown fields as absent. An unversioned contract is the one that silently changes meaning.

did.description: Optional. No DID -> repid_agents.id mapping exists yet; this is an OPEN blocker, so the router must not key on it.

capabilities.description: Each entry is a claim by the agent about itself. The router weights it by evidence, never by the claim alone.

domain.description: Free-form; the fleet's specialisation spread has not been measured, so no enum can be honest yet.

declared_competence.description: SELF-REPORTED. Unproven self-report contributes 0 to reputation (authority-policy invariants.unproven_self_report_delta_is_0); the same rule applies here — this number may inform routing priors, never authority.

evidence.description: Three levels, because two would collapse 'never tested' into 'failed'.

level.description: MEASURED requires observation_count > 0 AND a reference. NOT_CHECKED is the honest default for a new declaration and must NOT be read as competence 0 — it is absence of measurement, not measurement of absence.

success_rate.description: NULL when observation_count is 0. Not 0, and not 1 — a rate over an empty set is undefined.

measured_ref.description: Where the measurement lives. Required for MEASURED.

recency.description: Earned metrics decay with a 30-day half-life toward a prior of 0; a stale MEASURED is not a current one.

cost_hint.description: Priors for the ANFIS-TS local cost. Weights (alpha_c, alpha_l, alpha_d, alpha_pi) = (0.30, 0.30, 0.20, 0.20), summing to 1 — read from docs/policy/anfis-objective.md.

latency_ms.description: NULL is honest; no table records per-agent latency, so this is unmeasured fleet-wide.

evidence_posture.description: What the ROUTER is permitted to do with this declaration. Stated on the contract rather than left to each consumer, because that is where it drifts.

router_may_use.description: ANFIS's cold start IS the linear cost model — the honest cold start, not a fitted router with no fit. A declaration alone reaches cold_start_prior only.

degradation.description: hot/warm/cold rules are locked in the policy; the thresholds are PRIORS, not measurements, and must not be quoted as fitted.

may_grant_authority.description: PERMANENTLY false. A declaration never raises effectiveAuthority. A_eff = min(R_route, 100*sqrt(S_usd)) * 1[builder >= 500] and contains no self-declared term. Permitting true here would let an agent describe its way to a higher spending limit.

supersedes.description: Prior declaration id this replaces. Declarations are append-only; a router reading only the newest must still be able to find what changed.

x-unspecified: Signature or attestation over the declaration itself — the policy does not specify one, so nothing here binds a declaration to its declarer. Until it does, a declaration is unauthenticated input.
The capability namespace (no controlled vocabulary exists; sub-task routing granularity is OPEN and blocked on the task key).
How declarations are transported or discovered.
LASSO feature selection over declared capabilities — named in the roadmap, absent from both policy files.
